title: Bunny Robyn, the West Coast mastering engineer
summary: Master Recorders engineer Bunny Robyn mastered for Imperial and the independents and improved Matassa's poorer recordings.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: You didn't do it. I couldn't... You couldn't do it. Now, I'll say this. There was a guy, Bunny Robine, who was the mastering engineer for Imperial and all of the independents just about on the West Coast at master recorders. Bunny Robine... And that's spelled O-R-O-P-Y-N incidentally. Uh, uh, uh, uh, Bunny Robine was mastering as he did the transfers from, from tape to disc and disc to disc and things like that. Mm-hmm. And he was excellent. Very, very good. And, uh, he probably, you know, saved my chestnuts a few times with stuff that I did was fairly poor and he made it sound better before it came out. Given credit where credit is due, as they say. Did you find he did that a lot? I mean, when, uh, made your... Oh, well, I...
